stories.title: India's forex reserves fall $18.34 billion to $747.56 billion in week ended September 25
stories.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves fell to $747.56 billion during the week that ended on September 25. This decline was primarily driven by a decrease in foreign currency assets, which dropped to $615.411 billion. India's gold reserves also saw a reduction, declining to $108.701 billion during this period. Special Drawing Rights and the reserve position with the International Monetary Fund also experienced declines.
